issues.explanation: Guest-only routes protect the initial page load, but Livewire update requests do not re-apply guest middleware unless it is persisted, so an authenticated user could invoke Login/Register submit directly.
Livewire validation uses protected rules() instead of the project's required #[Validate] attributes plus $this->validate() pattern.
No unauthorized-call test for Livewire submit actions (authenticated user calling Login/Register submit via Livewire update).

conventions.evidence: Uses Blade components x-card/x-field, route() links, named redirects, Password::defaults; but rules() at app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:260 and Register.php:350 instead of #[Validate], and no Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware for guest group at routes/web.php:896-899

readability.evidence: app/Http/Controllers/ResetPasswordController.php:196, app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:272, resources/views/components/field.blade.php:1 small focused methods, clear names, no dead code

requirements.evidence: app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:289,275-286 throttle+auth.failed; app/Livewire/Auth/Register.php:365,389-396 register flow; app/Http/Controllers/ResetPasswordController.php:206-212 remember_token rotation; routes/web.php:896-920 contract paths; lang/en/ui.php:1 lang/pt_BR/ui.php:1

scope.evidence: change.diff:1-1708 only auth views/controllers/components/routes/docs/tests; no SCSS/JS or unrelated refactors

security.evidence: EmailVerificationRequest at app/Http/Controllers/Auth/EmailVerificationController.php:78, always-same status at ForgotPasswordController.php:130, remember_token rotation, {{ }} escaping; gap: guest middleware not persisted for Livewire updates

simplicity.evidence: Reuses User::EMAIL_RULES, Password::defaults(), EmailVerificationRequest, translation files; two small Blade components, no service layers

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/Auth/LoginTest.php:1, RegisterTest.php:1, EmailVerificationTest.php:978 tampered-id 403, PasswordResetTest.php:1387 rotation, LocalizationTest, ViewConventionsTest; missing Livewire unauthorized-call coverage

review.summary: Implements the full pt-BR session auth flow (Livewire login/register, logout, password reset, verification, localization) with thorough Pest coverage. Needs changes before merging: guest middleware is not persisted for Livewire updates and Livewire validation deviates from the #[Validate] pattern.
